content: MCP spec 2026-07-28 changelog (primary): stateless redesign — sessions + Mcp-Session-Id removed; initialize handshake removed; every request carries _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion + clientCapabilities (+clientInfo SHOULD); serverInfo SHOULD in result _meta; version mismatch -> UnsupportedProtocolVersionError. server/discover MUST (advertise versions/capabilities/identity; MAY be called first or as STDIO back-compat probe). subscriptions/listen replaces GET endpoint + resources/subscribe; progress/message notifications stay on request response stream. ping, logging/setLevel, roots/list_changed removed; logLevel per-request _meta; MUST NOT emit notifications/message unless requested. Tasks moved to extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks. MRTR replaces server-initiated elicitation/sampling/roots: InputRequiredResult resultType=input_required + inputRequests, client retries with inputResponses. Required resultType on all results (complete|input_required; absent from old servers = complete). SSE resumability/Last-Event-ID removed. tools/list SHOULD deterministic order (prompt-cache hits). Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers required on HTTP POST. ttlMs + cacheScope (public|private) REQUIRED on list results (CacheableResult). outputSchema/structuredContent loosened to any JSON Schema 2020-12 / any JSON value. Roots/Sampling/Logging DEPRECATED (12-month window); HTTP+SSE deprecated; error codes -32020..-32099 reserved (HeaderMismatch -32020, UnsupportedProtocolVersion -32022).
